App.Title: Sargas Compendium Manager
App.HowItWorks: Every world with Sargas Compendium Manager enabled opens these same compendiums. Edit them directly: there is nothing to sync, and switching worlds needs no preparation. Only run one world at a time.
App.Backups: Back up the library from Foundry's setup screen: Backups → Sargas Compendium Manager — Shared Library.

Health.MissingModuleTitle: The Shared Library module is not enabled in this world.
Health.MissingModuleBody: Sargas Compendium Manager keeps its content in the companion module “Sargas Compendium Manager — Shared Library”. Enable it in Manage Modules and reload.
Health.ShrankPack: {label}: had {was} entries the last time this world saw it, now has none.
Health.MetaMissing: The library's bookkeeping entry (.sargas-compendium-manager) is gone.
Health.ShrankBody: Nothing has been written to the library. Check that the folder Data/modules/sargas-compendium-manager-library is intact, or restore it from Foundry's Backups screen, then restart the world. If you emptied it on purpose, accept the current state.
Health.AcceptTitle: Accept the library as it is now?
Health.AcceptBody: The warning will clear and this world will treat the library's current contents as normal. Nothing is restored or deleted.

Leftovers.Title: Old compendiums from version 1.0.x
Leftovers.Intro: Version 1.0.x made a copy of the library in each world, named “… (Shared Library)”. They are not the shared library and nothing uses them any more.
Leftovers.Copied: {count} entries, all already in the shared library
Leftovers.Missing: {count} entries not in the shared library yet
Leftovers.Failed: could not be checked; see the console
Leftovers.ImportFirst: Bring in the compendiums that still hold entries before removing them: use “Bring in compendiums…” below. Once everything is in the shared library, they can be removed here.
Leftovers.ConfirmBody: These {count} compendiums from version 1.0.x will be deleted from this world. Everything in them is already in the shared library.
Leftovers.ConfirmPermanent: This cannot be undone. Your other world keeps its own copies until you remove them there too.
Leftovers.Kept: {count} old compendiums were kept because they hold entries that are not in the shared library.
Leftovers.Notice: Found {count} old “… (Shared Library)” compendiums from version 1.0.x. Open Sargas Compendium Manager to remove them.

Welcome.Title: Shared library ready
Welcome.Empty: The shared library is ready and empty.
Welcome.HasContent: The shared library is ready. It already holds:
Welcome.HowItWorks: Look for the “Sargas Compendium Manager” folder in the Compendium sidebar. Everything you put in those compendiums is available in every world that enables Sargas Compendium Manager — there is nothing to sync.
Welcome.Offer: Do you want to bring in compendiums you already have in this world?

Import.Title: Bring compendiums into the shared library
Import.Intro: Tick the compendiums to bring in. You will see a preview before anything is written, and nothing is ever deleted from either side.
Import.NoSources: This world has no compendiums to bring in.
Import.IncludeAll: Also show module and system compendiums
Import.RewriteLinks: Point links at the shared library
Import.RewriteLinksHint: Links inside the imported entries that point at other imported entries are changed to point at their shared copies.
Import.LockSourcesHint: So you do not keep editing the old copy by accident. You can unlock them again from the compendium's context menu.

Depth.source: same id or same original pf2e entry
Depth.name: same id, original entry, or name and type

Import.PreviewFailed: The preview failed. See the console for details.
Import.DecisionsHint: These entries already exist in the library with different content. The library version is kept unless you choose otherwise.
Import.NothingToDo: Nothing would be written: everything is already in the library or set to keep the library version.
Import.ConfirmBody: {count} entries will be written to the shared library.
Import.ConfirmReplace: {count} of them replace the library's version, in every world.
Import.ConfirmNoDelete: Nothing will be deleted. You can run this again at any time.
Import.Failed: The import failed. See the console for details.
Import.SomeFailed: {count} entries could not be written. See the console for details.
Import.LibraryUnhealthy: Importing is disabled while the shared library health check is failing. Open the Sargas Compendium Manager window for details.
Import.DoneHint: Imported entries sit in a folder named after the compendium they came from. They are available in every world now.

Errors.WrongSystem: Sargas Compendium Manager only supports the {system} system and is inactive in this world.
Errors.SystemMismatch: The shared library was created for the {recorded} system but this world runs {current}. Sargas Compendium Manager will not configure it, to protect your data.
Errors.VersionDrift: The shared library was last used with system version {recorded}; this world runs {current}. Keeping both worlds on the same version is recommended.
Errors.LibraryMissing: Sargas Compendium Manager needs the companion module {id}. Enable “Sargas Compendium Manager — Shared Library” in Manage Modules and reload.
Errors.LibraryShrank: The shared library looks emptied since this world last saw it. Nothing has been written. Open Sargas Compendium Manager for details.
Errors.MissingPacks: These shared compendiums are missing from the library install: {packs}.
Errors.NotPrimaryGM: Another GM is the active GM in this world; only they can import.
Errors.StartupFailed: Sargas Compendium Manager could not start. See the console for details.

SyncPackOwnership.Name: Carry pack ownership between worlds
SyncPackOwnership.Hint: Pack ownership is a per-world setting. With this on, the ownership you configure for a shared compendium in one world is applied in the other.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Write verbose [sargas-compendium-manager] messages to the browser console.
